prompt: In this watercolor illustration, a bustling school science fair unfolds with soft edges and blended hues. On the left stands a tall boy in a blue hoodie holding a bubbling green flask. Next to him, a girl with pigtails points at the flask while wearing yellow sneakers. A white rabbit sits on a wooden table beside them, twitching its nose. In the center, a teacher in a gray suit looks at a poster board covered in charts. Beside the teacher, a small robot with wheels rolls forward slowly. A cat with orange stripes sleeps on top of the robot's charging station. To the right, a man in a red scarf examines a volcano model made of clay. A brown dog sniffs the base of the volcano model curiously. Behind the man, a woman in a green dress hands a ribbon to a smiling child in overalls. The child holds a trophy tightly with both hands. Near the back wall, a stack of textbooks leans precariously against a metal chair. A bird with blue feathers perches on the top book. An elderly man with glasses reads a notebook near the bird. A young girl in a pink shirt watches the elderly man intently. A silver microscope sits on a separate table nearby. A boy in a striped shirt adjusts the lens of the microscope. A potted cactus rests on the floor under the microscope table. There is no digital screen visible in the scene. There is no fluorescent lighting fixture overhead. There is no plastic banner hanging from the ceiling. The soft washes of color define the space without harsh lines, capturing the gentle chaos of student projects and curious observers mingling in the hall.
